items.html: For after they were back to back and he gave her the aspect of the Gevurot, afterward the mochin departed from him, and only Bina and Gevura were given to the Nukva by Ima, and they are harsh judgments. Then the mochin that departed — namely Hochma and Hesed, which remained as Makifim, as is known — became Mayin Nukvin, and Aba and Ima coupled and brought out other MNTzPCh; and the Gevurot were renewed and sweetened now, for indeed they are more sweetened judgments. And all the mochin, with the new MNTzPCh, return to enter within ZA, and are drawn to the Nukva by him throughout the nine days of repentance.
